title: Operation Analyst/ Business Analyst
text: Operation Analyst/ Business Analyst at SHL (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). About SHL SHL, the global leader in talent innovation, helps companies transform productivity through deeper people insight. Powering the future of business, our data and tools are proven to drive stronger, more sustainable business outcomes. Our unrivalled assessment science, benchmark data and analytics empower leaders and their teams to make confident, data-driven people decisions, when it matters most – transforming the way organisations recruit, manage and develop talent. With 40-years of talent expertise, we're a trusted technology partner to more than 10,000 companies in 150 countries, including 80% of the FTSE 100 and 50% of the Fortune Global 500. Learn more at shl.com About the role We are currently seeking a Full-Time Operations Analyst, reporting to the Commercial Operations Manager, for the SHL Talent Assessment business in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ). As early career role, you'll be taking on a full range of activities to support the business, including but not limited to sales operations, qualitative and quantitative data analysis. Responsibilities include: Leveraging data from a variety of sources to build internal and external dashboards and reports Weekly collation, analysis and distribution of various performance metrics and reports Review of contracts and orders prior to submission, to ensure accuracy and compliance with the internal policies Providing ad-hoc support to the local sales team, including order processing, internal training of systems, tools and technology platforms Liaising with the central support centre to address any order or system related issue Enhancing internal processes, tools and templates to support business operations Providing general decision support and commercial analysis, as required to enable informed decisions Maintaining data quality and accuracy across the CRM platform When you join SHL, you will have A culture comprised of diverse, global teams who have a passion for high achievement, collaboration and client service. The opportunity to be a part of a company distinguished by its insights and world-class talent management solutions. We’re looking for a strong candidate with these qualifications: Tertiary qualifications in Business, Economics, Finance or other related topics Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel Proven analytical, data modelling and reporting experience Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to work with various technology platforms and systems High level of accuracy and attention to details Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills Desired Experience and Qualifications: Prior exposure to Sales or Commercial function is desirable Experience working with large scale BI and CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce.com)
